checks.title: Production build completes without errors
checks.steps: Run 'npm run build' and verify build completes successfully with no TypeScript or build errors
checks.notes: Build completed successfully. Generated 30 static pages. All routes compiled properly including API routes, auth pages, and dashboard. No TypeScript errors. First Load JS shared by all: 102 kB.

checks.title: Unit tests pass

checks.notes: All 59 tests passed across 2 test files. Tests completed in 502ms. Crypto tests included in passing tests.

checks.title: Database can be generated

checks.notes: Prisma Client (v7.7.0) generated successfully to ./node_modules/@prisma/client in 148ms. Generation completed without errors.

checks.title: OAuth tokens are encrypted
checks.steps: Read src/lib/crypto.ts and verify the encryptToken/decryptToken functions use AES-256-GCM encryption. Run the crypto tests to validate
checks.notes: Verified src/lib/crypto.ts: encrypt() and decrypt() functions use AES-256-GCM encryption (const ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm' at line 6). Uses 64-byte salt, 16-byte IV, 16-byte authTag. PBKDF2 with 100,000 iterations for key derivation. All 59 unit tests pass including crypto validation.

checks.notes: Verified src/modules/queues/jobs.ts lines 588-663: runRollup() fetches subscriptions where action='rollup' (lines 610-620), builds digest with subject 'Your Prunebox Subscription Digest (X subscriptions)' (line 628), formats subscription list with unsubscribe info (lines 631-639), calls sendEmail() to user.email (line 654).

checks.notes: Verified src/modules/queues/jobs.ts lines 433-582: runBulkDelete() searches with multiple patterns - exact senderEmail and domain variant (lines 472-490), collects unique message IDs in Set (lines 483-490), calls batchDeleteMessages() with all IDs (line 521), updates BulkDeletionJob with totalMessages and deletedMessages counts (lines 507-510).

checks.title: Gmail webhook verifies signature and processes notifications
checks.steps: Read src/app/api/webhook/gmail/route.ts and verify POST endpoint extracts x-goog-signature header, uses crypto.timingSafeEqual() for HMAC SHA256 verification against GMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET, decodes base64 message.data, returns 401 if signature invalid
checks.notes: Verified src/app/api/webhook/gmail/route.ts: POST endpoint extracts x-goog-signature header (line 53), verifyWebhookSignature() uses crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret) (line 29) and crypto.timingSafeEqual() for constant-time comparison (line 42), decodes base64 message.data (line 76), returns ApiErrorResponse.unauthorized() with 401 status if signature invalid (line 58).
